text:
alex.c: Heads-up — planning a slow rollout for the model-serving change today. Target deploy window 14:00–15:00 PT. I'll own the deploy but need a quick hand with smoke checks and rollback readiness.

maria.g: Ack. I'm available for smoke between 14:10–14:40 PT. Which cohorts are we hitting first?

alex.c: Start with 0.5% internal + 0.5% beta orgs, then 2% canary pool, then 10% broad mobile. Final ramp to 100% only if perf looks good.

leo_ops: Noted. Which regions? I'd like eu-west held until we confirm latency in us-east.

alex.c: Good call — us-east first (prod-groups A/B), then us-west, hold eu until post-10% validated.

devon: Quick checklist: smoke script is under tools/smoke/deploy_smoke.sh (uses /health and a few sample prompts). I'll run it after the config push.

alex.c: Pasting commands:
```bash
# verify service is up
curl -sSf https://api.redwood-prod.example/health
# sample gen latency and correctness
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-prod.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test guardrail","max_tokens":8}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY"
# check pod status
kubectl --context=prod get pods -l app=model-serving -o wide
```

maria.g: I'll watch the gen latency and token cost metrics in the console. If token p50 > 250ms or error rate > 0.5% we pause. :warning:

leo_ops: On rollback: we have the previous image tagged `model-serving:v2026-04-12`. If we need to revert, I'll trigger: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving --to-revision=3` and alert oncall.

devon: Also pre-warm KV cache for the warm cohort: run `python tools/prewarm.py --cohort=mobile-10pct --keys=10000` after the 2% step.

alex.c: Timeline notes:
- 14:00 config push + deploy start
- 14:05 health probes green -> promote to internal 0.5%
- 14:10 smoke run + metrics window (5m)
- 14:20 ramp to 2% canary
- 14:30 prewarm and 10% mobile
- 14:50 evaluate, decide final ramp or rollback

maria.g: If any of these steps fail, what's the stop condition? Explicit thresholds?

alex.c: Stop/rollback triggers:
- error rate spike > 0.5% sustained 5m
- 99th percentile latency > 2s
- generation quality regression on eval set (devon will run quick eval)
If any trigger fires, we immediately pause ramp and rollback if issues persist after 10m.

devon: I'll run a quick eval suite (50 prompts) after 2% ramp and post results here. Plan to post eval summary in 5m.

leo_ops: I'll prepare the rollback playbook in the runbook channel and make sure the oncall pager is notified. Also will have SSH ready to nodes for quick logs.

deploy-bot: Deployment kickoff recorded: user=alex.c, release=model-serving:v2026-05-05, thread=1768504321

sara.k: minor ask — can we gate the rollout against a watchlist of top 20 enterprise orgs so we avoid affecting them?

alex.c: Yes — using routing rules: enterprise orgs are excluded until final ramp. I'll add that to the deploy config and push with the release.

maria.g: Running smoke now (14:12 PT): health OK, sample gens look good, p50=110ms, p95=420ms, errors=0.12%.

devon: Eval after 2% (14:27): 50 prompts passed semantic checks, 2 minor formatting diffs. No regressions on safety filters. Posting full diff link: https://ci.redwood/example/eval/1768504321

leo_ops: Prewarm kicked for mobile-10pct at 14:33, KV hit rate ~86% after run.

alex.c: All right — moving to 10% mobile at 14:35. Monitoring console and traces.

maria.g: Observing slight p95 bump to 520ms at 14:37, watching. Error rate stable.

alex.c: Let's hold at 10% for 15m. If no new issues, we plan final ramp to 100% at 14:55.

devon: No red flags from eval side. I'm standing by to run additional prompts if needed.

leo_ops: If rollback required, I'll coordinate with infra to remove new image from registry and reapply the previous tag. Also will notify customer success if any customer-facing regressions are detected.

maria.g: 14:49 status: p50=130ms, p95=480ms, errors=0.08% — OK to proceed.

alex.c: Proceeding with final ramp to 100% at 14:55. Deploy-bot, kick final job.

deploy-bot: Final rollout started by alex.c for model-serving:v2026-05-05. Staged ramping: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 2m checks.

maria.g: Post-ramp checks positive at 15:05. Metrics look stable, no rollout incidents. Great job team. :tada:

alex.c: Thanks everyone — I'll close the thread and update the release notes. If any post-deploy regressions pop up, re-open here or ping oncall.

leo_ops: Adding brief postmortem checklist to the release PR (backup image, logs location, incident contacts).

devon: Leaving the eval artifacts link in the release PR too.

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: success.
